evidence_slice: Historic England NHLE List Entry 1495589 identifies Exeter Central Station, 3 Central Station Buildings, Queen Street, Exeter, EX4 3SB, as a Grade II listed railway station first listed 24 July 2026. The official entry gives National Grid Reference SX9186692958 and describes the railway station with attached shops, offices and footbridge. Historic England's official NHLE v02 layer 3 is the Listed Building polygons feature layer. This new source window converted only the published NGR to WGS84 for query addressing and used a point spatial-intersects GeoJSON request at approximately -3.533393,50.726148 with returnGeometry=true and fields ListEntry, Name and Grade. The retrieval channel rejected the parameterized official query URL before any feature payload was available. No polygon coordinates were read, inferred or fabricated.
